input.quote: The parties agree to the following non-binding sales and marketing cooperation efforts:
input.rationale: No provision imposes exclusivity or sole/preferred-source obligations on Corio (our party). Section 2 grants are all "nonexclusive" licenses to Corio, which limits the scope of rights granted but does not restrict Corio from licensing or hosting competing software; Section 2.4 and 2.9 likewise are permissive. Exhibit D (Sales and Marketing Cooperation) is expressly "non-binding" and contains only cooperative cross-selling, joint marketing and relationship-manager commitments — no requirement to lead with or exclusively promote Commerce One products, and no minimum purchase or requirements commitment appears in Exhibit B pricing/revenue share. Section 14.8 confirms Corio solely directs the Corio Services and may subcontract to third parties. The only exclusivity language in the document runs the other way or is neutral (Commerce One's warranty of sole ownership at Section 7.1, Corio's "sole and exclusive remedies" at Section 7, the "exclusive agreement" integration clause at Section 14.10, and Section 2.4's restriction on Commerce One contacting Corio Customers, which benefits us). Accordingly the preferred position — no exclusivity obligation on the customer — is met and no redline is required.
